subject: SparkBridge POC: hands-on session & load-profile windows
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@sparkbridge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: SparkBridge POC: proposed hands-on windows and brief agenda

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the interest in running a hands-on POC with Redwood. A couple of windows that work on our side for a two-hour working session:

- Tue Oct 12, 10:00–12:00 PDT
- Thu Oct 14, 13:00–15:00 PDT

Draft agenda (attached: sparkbridge_poc_agenda.pdf):
- 10m introductions & goals
- 30m prompt walkthrough and evaluation criteria
- 40m routing & inference config (routing rules, model variants)
- 30m light load test (throughput pattern, KV/prefix cache)
- 10m next steps & owners

We should include Marcus to lead routing discussion and Dev to run the light load test — cc'd. If neither window works, let me know alternative slots and which timezone your team prefers.

Also: if you want us to include a short pre-populated prompt set, send an example doc and we’ll load it before the session.

Cheers,

Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@sparkbridge.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@sparkbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkBridge POC: proposed hands-on windows and brief agenda

Hi Tessa —

Thanks — Thu Oct 14 13:00–15:00 PDT looks best for our group (execs have conflicts on the 12th). Can you add a short load-test plan to the agenda — we want to validate steady throughput at ~60 rpm and also a short burst scenario. Please also include routing scenarios for:

- high-confidence direct answers to the knowledge base
- low-confidence fallback to a safer model

Looping in Tom (technical lead) who will bring two folks from CloudOps.

If you can send a calendar invite and any promised attachments, we’ll confirm internally.

Best,
Ellen
Director of Product, SparkBridge
ellen.park@sparkbridge.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>

Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SparkBridge POC: proposed hands-on windows and brief agenda

Great — locking Thu Oct 14, 13:00–15:00 PDT tentatively and sending the invite shortly.

Per your ask, attached is a brief recommended load approach (sparkbridge_ma_plan.pdf):
- steady run: 60 req/min for 20 minutes (measure latency & token cost)
- burst run: +3x for 2 minutes to validate autoscale tap-in/out thresholds
- KV/prefix cache check: three warm vs cold prefixes (observe perf delta)

Routing scenarios (proposed owners):
- Marcus to walk the routing policy and can demo model fallback rules
- Dev to own the load test harness and collect metrics (we’ll create short CloudWatch/Grafana links)
- Laura to capture notes/action items and schedule follow-up

Attachments: sparkbridge_ma_plan.pdf (load plan) and a session-runbook stub — I’ll upload the runbook to the shared Drive and add link in the invite.

Action items now:
1) Marcus: finalize routing test cases (due 2026-10-08)
2) Dev: prepare load harness and test dataset (due 2026-10-12)
3) SparkBridge: confirm final participant list by Oct 8

I’ll send the calendar invite for Oct 14 PDT once I confirm Marcus and Dev availability — if we need to shift, we can pivot to your alternate slot.

Thanks,
Tessa

Confirmed: Fri Oct 15, 09:00–11:00 PDT is good for Redwood — calendar invite sent (link above). Final attendee list: Ellen, Tom, CloudOps (2), Marcus (routing), Dev (load harness), Laura (notes).

Final agenda for the working session:
- 09:00–09:10: goals & success metrics (SparkBridge)
- 09:10–09:40: prompt review & evaluation criteria (SparkBridge + Tessa)
- 09:40–10:20: routing policy walkthrough & demo (Marcus)
- 10:20–10:50: load test: steady 60 rpm then 2m burst (Dev)
- 10:50–11:00: action items & next steps (Laura captures owners/times)

Post-session plan: Laura will send a recap with timestamps, artifacts (run logs, perf graphs) and proposed follow-up (30–45m deep-dive on regressions if needed). Tentative follow-up meeting: Tue Oct 19 — we’ll confirm during the recap.

Attachments: session_runbook_stub.docx (runbook template we’ll use during the test).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
